title: Kenyan Stew with Olive and Citrus
description: A flavorful and spicy stew originating from Kenya, made with tender chunks of meat and fragrant spices, served with a squeeze of fresh citrus and a drizzle of olive oil.

ingredients.name: kenyan spices (ground cumin, coriander, and turmeric)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew meat and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the kenyan spices, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the diced tomatoes and water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Stir in the citrus juice and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
